items.title: Reverend Robert H. Owen Interview, 1964-09-25
items.q: Then when I was all... I was all done, I just, you know, in complete shock, I said, Well, I can go home and die now. I just played with the king.

ctx.x: You just took whatever was available. Yeah. Yeah. Then, uh, actually my big jump in learning tunes came when I was in Montana. When were you there? Well, first I served churches in Arkansas. No, wait, I'm sorry. It was in Louisiana when I became a member of the Baton Rouge Jazz Club. Oh, yes. And, uh, I used to play there. Uh, we had a meeting once a month and we used to, you know, listen to records for half the DA and then play for the rather half. And then I went from there to... Anybody in their band that, uh,…
